name: secret-guard
description: Block accidental reads of .env and secret key files via Read tool or Bash commands

name: dangerous-cmd-guard
description: Hard-block destructive shell commands (rm -rf /, unanchored cleanup wildcards like /tmp/*, force push, reset --hard, DROP DATABASE, etc.)

name: large-file-guard
description: Ask before overwriting an existing file that has more than 500 lines

name: lint-on-save
description: Run the project linter after source file edits (JS/TS, Python, Go, Ruby)

name: secret-in-write-guard
description: Hard-block writing content that contains secret or token patterns (API keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, etc.)

name: format-on-save
description: Run the project formatter on edited source files in-place (JS/TS, Python, Go, Ruby)

name: test-on-save
description: Run the associated test file after editing a source file — skips if no test file found (JS/TS, Go, Python, Ruby). Advisory only.

name: graphify-read-guard
description: Gate source-file reads/globs behind a tapering graphify-query cadence (5 → 3 → 1 queries to unlock, ~6 reads per cycle) instead of a flat timer — requires the graphify skill and an existing graphify-out/graph.json. Ships disabled; enable only in projects that maintain a graphify knowledge graph.

name: graphify-session-sentinel
description: Track graphify query/path/explain usage toward graphify-read-guard's tapering gate by incrementing the shared session state — pairs with graphify-read-guard. Ships disabled by default.

name: graphify-grep-nudge
description: Soft-nudge toward `graphify query` (via additionalContext, never a block) when grep-like Bash commands or the Grep tool run and a graphify knowledge graph exists — pairs with graphify-read-guard. Ships disabled by default.
